name: Ruben Keller
life: “Our club borrowed its first ledger from a defunct fishworkers' society.” Monday often includes a stop at the steps at Pier Beach, where Ruben watches the working part of the waterfront before turning toward the open water.
voice: Our boat club wants an official name. I brought nine unofficial ones on a damp receipt.
appearance: Ruben is easy to recognize by dark brown curls cut close behind the ears and a round face with a pronounced chin. Usually dressed in a washed violet jersey with a knotted piece of sail thread on a key ring, Ruben counts on the side of one finger where hardly anybody notices when listening.
personality: Ruben treats keeping somebody waiting as a serious discourtesy. This can turn a helpful person into an impatient one when everybody else needs a slower conversation.
agenda: To publish the nine old names beside the club's proposal.
family: Sasha Crane is Ruben’s half-sibling. Ruben picks the meeting place. Sasha sets the time to leave. It lets them stay close without turning a family visit into the loss of an entire day. They have both had stretches when that distinction mattered. Asked about *The broken till*, Sasha says, “I wasn't hungry. I joined the queue because it felt like the first real conversation since my divorce.”
connections: Percy Andrade. They decide which decidedly unofficial name can appear on the choir sheet.
